judgmentProtocol.source: AI-authored hypothetical Vietnamese post text and scenario judgments; no user data, telemetry, or independent human review.
judgmentProtocol.limitations: Bootstrap evaluation of reranking within a fixed eligible candidate pool. It does not measure retrieval recall, real-user relevance, label accuracy at scale, or launch quality. Do not tune production weights from this set alone.
